composition.value: Public domain in the United States; Commons’ life-plus-70 claim is not supported as of 2026.
composition.note: The 1904 publication supports US expiry. Sibelius died in 1957, so an ordinary life-plus-70 term runs through 31 December 2027. This conflicts with the file’s unqualified PD-old-70 tag. The unidentified arranger’s rights are also unestablished.

alternatives.value: Commons applies PD-old-70, asserting expiry in the source country and life-plus-70 jurisdictions.
The standard life-plus-70 term for Sibelius’s composition runs through 31 December 2027; US publication-based expiry is separate.

recording.note: Commons labels the file public domain using PD-US-expired and PD-old-70. Those general-work tags do not establish the recording-specific US term. The source documents a 1925 session but not first publication; under § 1401, US expiry depends on first publication. A worldwide recording clearance is not established.
